name: @runsecure/hkdfguard-integration-hashicorpvault
description: HkdfGuard's integration with HashiCorp Vault (Node's own HTTPS client, no third-party dependency): a Vault client with tokens held only protected by the key ring, and what every HkdfGuard Vault integration shares - address and token checks, TLS with password-protected PKCS#12 key stores, retries and the token sources.
